headline: Insulin worked in January, Mussolini took Rome in October, and Carter found Tutankhamun in November
texture: Frederick Banting treated a diabetic patient with insulin on January 11 and it worked, turning a fatal diagnosis into a managed one. Howard Carter found the tomb of Tutankhamun on November 4, largely intact. The Treaty on the Creation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics pulled several republics into one state in December, and the Irish Free State came into existence on December 6 with George V as its king.

Mussolini's National Fascist Party marched on Rome in October and he was prime minister by the thirty-first, at thirty-nine the youngest Italy had had. The British Broadcasting Company started radio service on November 14. Harding made his first radio speech on June 14, five months after DeWitt and Lila Wallace put out the first issue of Reader's Digest.

Douglas Fairbanks took $2,101,044 in rentals with Robin Hood, the year's biggest. Valentino came second in Blood and Sand. Harold Lloyd's Grandma's Boy made $1,100,000 for Pathe. The Hollywood Bowl opened on July 11, the Lincoln Memorial was dedicated on May 30, and the New York Giants beat the New York Yankees in the World Series for the second year running.

world.tutankhamun.label: Tutankhamun's tomb found
world.tutankhamun.value: Howard Carter located it in the Valley of the Kings

world.ussr.label: Soviet Union formed
world.ussr.value: The Treaty on the Creation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics united several republics into one state

world.irish_free_state.label: Irish Free State established
world.irish_free_state.value: Came into existence on December 6, with George V as king and a constitution enacted by the Dail on October 25
world.irish_free_state.detail: The British Parliament passed the Irish Free State Constitution Act the day before.

world.poland_president.label: Poland's first president
world.poland_president.value: Gabriel Narutowicz was elected on December 9 and sworn in on December 11

film.gross.label: Highest-grossing films, US domestic rentals
film.gross.detail: Rentals, the distributor share rather than the ticket window total, so roughly half what a gross figure would say.

film.hollywood_bowl.label: Hollywood Bowl opens
film.hollywood_bowl.value: The open-air venue held its first season

film.how_people_watched.label: How people watched
film.how_people_watched.value: In a theatre, silent, with an organ or orchestra playing to the picture. Five years before a feature spoke.

radio.bbc.label: The BBC starts broadcasting
radio.bbc.value: The British Broadcasting Company began radio service in the United Kingdom

radio.us_stations.label: Stations multiplying in America
radio.us_stations.value: KGU began in Hawaii on May 11 and WJAM in Cedar Rapids on July 30, two of hundreds licensed as the boom took hold

tech.insulin.label: Insulin treats diabetes
tech.insulin.value: Frederick Banting gave the first successful insulin treatment to a diabetic patient

tech.readers_digest.label: Reader's Digest
tech.readers_digest.value: DeWitt and Lila Wallace published the first issue

culture.mood.label: Mood
culture.mood.value: Radio sets appearing in parlours, a fascist government in Rome, and an Egyptian tomb on every front page at once.

sports.world_series.value: New York Giants beat the New York Yankees again

sports.negro_league.label: Negro National League
sports.negro_league.value: Chicago American Giants took a third consecutive pennant

notes: Research pass July 2026. No prices section: the three price series all start later. The Soviet Union fact carries a month rather than a day because the source describes the treaty without dating it precisely. Deaths carry a birth year rather than an age because the source gives only the year.
